categories.title: Files, hashes and sandboxes
categories.blurb: Check a hash, file or URL against known malware, then detonate it somewhere safe and watch what it does.

categories.title: IPs, domains and infrastructure
categories.blurb: Who is behind an address, what it has been caught doing, and whether it is hiding behind a proxy.

categories.title: Code and site-source search
categories.blurb: Find a tracking ID, hostname or odd string across public code and the source of live websites.

categories.title: Aircraft, ships and vehicles
categories.blurb: Live and historical movement of aircraft, vessels and vehicles.

categories.title: Conflict and live situation maps
categories.blurb: Front lines, strikes and events, mapped and kept current.

categories.title: Geolocation and imagery
categories.blurb: Pin down where and when a photo or video was taken.

categories.title: Sun, shadows, time and weather
categories.blurb: Work out when a photo was taken, or narrow down where, from the sun, shadows, time zones and the weather on the day.

categories.title: Image and video verification
categories.blurb: Reverse search, metadata and manipulation checks.

categories.title: People and accounts
categories.blurb: Usernames, email addresses and phone numbers across platforms.

categories.title: Companies, sanctions and crypto
categories.blurb: Ownership, officers, sanctions lists and money on chain.

categories.title: Courts, FOI and public records
categories.blurb: Court judgments, official notices, freedom-of-information answers and regulators' registers. Mostly UK, where the records are unusually open.

categories.title: Archives and web history
categories.blurb: What a page said before someone changed or removed it.

categories.title: Methods and reference
categories.blurb: How-to guides and maintained indexes for when the tool you need is not listed here.

tools.name: VirusTotal
tools.note: Run a hash, file, URL, domain or IP past dozens of engines, then follow the relations graph to linked samples and infrastructure.

tools.name: MalwareBazaar
tools.note: abuse.ch's open malware repository. Search by hash, tag, signature or YARA rule and pull the sample for analysis.

tools.name: ANY.RUN
tools.note: Interactive sandbox: detonate a file or URL and click through it live while process, network and ATT&CK activity is recorded.

tools.name: Hybrid Analysis
tools.note: Free sandbox with detailed behavioural reports, plus a large searchable archive of other people's submissions.

tools.name: AbuseIPDB
tools.note: Community-reported abuse history for an IP address: who reported it, when, and for what, from brute forcing to port scanning.

tools.name: Scamalytics
tools.note: Fraud risk score for an IP address, flagging proxies, VPNs, Tor exits and datacentre ranges.

tools.name: Freedar
tools.note: UK community flight tracker built on ADS-B and MLAT feeds, showing military and private aircraft that commercial trackers often hide.

tools.name: DeepStateMap
tools.note: Daily-updated map of the front line in Ukraine, showing occupied ground, contested areas and recent advances.

tools.name: CyberChef
tools.note: GCHQ's browser toolkit for decoding, decompressing and converting almost anything: base64, gzip, XOR, hex and hundreds more, chained into recipes.

tools.name: urlscan.io
tools.note: Loads a URL in a sandbox and records screenshots, the DOM and every request, then lets you pivot on IPs, hashes and domains across historic scans.

tools.name: threatYeti
tools.note: alphaMountain's search engine for domain, URL and IP threat intelligence: a risk score, categories, risk factors and related hosts on a shared IP. Five free lookups a day as a guest, more with a free account.

tools.name: Have I Been Squatted
tools.note: Generates typosquat and lookalike permutations of a domain and shows which are registered, with DNS, certificate and screenshot context. Good for brand-impersonation and phishing-kit work.

tools.name: Shodan
tools.note: Internet-wide scan data: which services, banners and software versions an IP exposes, and every other host that matches.

tools.name: Censys
tools.note: Host and certificate search with deep service fingerprints; strong for tracking a server set-up across IPs.

tools.name: Validin
tools.note: Passive DNS and host-response history with a generous free tier; quick for following an actor's infrastructure over time.

tools.name: crt.sh
tools.note: Certificate Transparency search. Finds a domain's subdomains, and new look-alike domains the moment they get a certificate.

tools.name: GreyNoise
tools.note: Tells you whether an IP is background internet-wide scanning or something aimed at you.

tools.name: airplanes.live
tools.note: Community-run, unfiltered ADS-B map: military and blocked aircraft stay visible, with history playback.

tools.name: ADS-B Exchange
tools.note: The long-running unfiltered ADS-B network, with global coverage and track history.

tools.name: MarineTraffic
tools.note: Live AIS positions for ships worldwide, with vessel details and port calls.

tools.name: Global Fishing Watch
tools.note: AIS combined with satellite radar detections, so it shows vessels running dark with AIS switched off.

tools.name: DVLA vehicle enquiry
tools.note: Official UK check of a number plate: make, colour, tax and MOT status, first registration.

tools.name: MOT history
tools.note: Every MOT test for a UK vehicle, with mileage at each test and the faults found.

tools.name: Platesmania
tools.note: Crowd-sourced photos of number plates; useful for matching a vehicle to a place and time.

tools.name: GeoConfirmed
tools.note: Volunteer-geolocated footage from several conflicts, each pinned to the map with its source.

tools.name: Liveuamap
tools.note: Near-real-time incident map built from news and social media, covering many regions.

tools.name: NASA FIRMS
tools.note: Satellite thermal detections within hours of a pass; often the first confirmation of a strike or a large fire.

tools.name: GPSJam
tools.note: Daily map of GPS interference, worked out from what aircraft report.

tools.name: Oryx
tools.note: Lists of military equipment losses where every entry links to photo or video proof.

tools.name: ACLED
tools.note: Structured, coded data on political violence and protest worldwide. Free account needed for downloads.

tools.name: Copernicus Browser
tools.note: Free Sentinel satellite imagery with time-lapse and comparison, often only days old.

tools.name: Bellingcat OSM Search
tools.note: Finds places by a combination of features, such as a church near a railway line and a river.

tools.name: Overpass Turbo
tools.note: Write your own OpenStreetMap queries when a ready-made search is not precise enough.

tools.name: SunCalc
tools.note: Sun position and shadow direction for any place and time; the standard way to date a photo from its shadows.

tools.name: PeakVisor
tools.note: 3D terrain with named peaks; match a mountain skyline in a photo to where it was taken.

tools.name: Google Earth
tools.note: 3D imagery everywhere. Google Earth Pro on desktop adds historical imagery, often going back decades.

tools.name: InVID-WeVerify plugin
tools.note: Browser extension for verifying video and images: keyframes, reverse search, metadata and forensic filters.

tools.name: Yandex Images
tools.note: The strongest reverse image search for places, buildings and faces.

tools.name: TinEye
tools.note: Finds where else an image has appeared; sort by oldest to find the earliest copy.

tools.name: Google Lens
tools.note: General reverse image search; good on products, text and landmarks.

tools.name: Forensically
tools.note: Error level analysis, clone detection and noise analysis in the browser, to spot edited regions.

tools.name: ExifTool
tools.note: The reference tool for reading and writing file metadata: camera, GPS, timestamps, software.

tools.name: WhatsMyName
tools.note: Checks a username across hundreds of sites at once.

tools.name: Epieos
tools.note: What an email address or phone number is registered to, including linked Google accounts.

tools.name: OSINT Industries
tools.note: Email, phone or username lookups across a very wide range of services, with results in one report.

tools.name: Sherlock
tools.note: Command-line username search across hundreds of social networks.

tools.name: Companies House
tools.note: Official register of UK companies: officers, owners, filings and addresses, all searchable.

tools.name: OpenCorporates
tools.note: The largest open database of companies worldwide, across many jurisdictions.

tools.name: OCCRP Aleph
tools.note: Search across leaks, registries and investigative datasets gathered by OCCRP journalists.

tools.name: OpenSanctions
tools.note: Sanctions lists, politically exposed people and criminal watchlists merged into one search.

tools.name: Arkham
tools.note: Crypto analytics that labels who owns which wallets, and traces flows between them.

tools.name: mempool.space
tools.note: Open-source Bitcoin explorer for transactions, addresses and fees.

tools.name: Wayback Machine
tools.note: Snapshots of the web going back to 1996, plus Save Page Now to archive something before it changes.

tools.name: archive.today
tools.note: On-demand snapshots that often capture pages the Wayback Machine cannot, such as social media posts.

tools.name: Bellingcat Online Investigation Toolkit
tools.note: Bellingcat's maintained, annotated index of tools and how to use them, by investigation type.

tools.name: Triage
tools.note: Fast sandbox with strong malware family detection and config extraction: C2 addresses and keys pulled straight out of the sample.

tools.name: Malpedia
tools.note: Encyclopedia of malware families: aliases, the actors using them, YARA rules and curated reporting for each.

tools.name: ThreatFox
tools.note: abuse.ch's shared feed of indicators tied to named malware: C2 servers, payload URLs and hashes.

tools.name: URLhaus
tools.note: abuse.ch's database of URLs currently serving malware, with the payloads they drop.

tools.name: SecurityTrails
tools.note: Historical DNS and WHOIS: see what a domain pointed to before it moved, and what else shared its IP.

tools.name: RIPEstat
tools.note: Authoritative routing data for any IP or AS: who holds it, where it is announced, and how that has changed.

tools.name: Hurricane Electric BGP Toolkit
tools.note: Quick lookups for ASNs, prefixes and peers; the fastest way to see who owns a range and what else they announce.

tools.name: OpenSky Network
tools.note: Research-grade archive of ADS-B data; the place to go for historical flight tracks.

tools.name: Planespotters.net
tools.note: Airframe histories by registration or serial: operators, re-registrations and photos.

tools.name: Mapillary
tools.note: Crowd-sourced street-level imagery, often where Google Street View has never been.

tools.name: GeoHints
tools.note: Country-by-country visual clues: bollards, road markings, plates, poles and scripts.

tools.name: Have I Been Pwned
tools.note: Which known data breaches an email address appears in, and what was exposed.

tools.name: Intelligence X
tools.note: Search engine over leaks, pastes, the dark web and historical web data, by email, domain, IP or crypto address.

tools.name: TGStat
tools.note: Search and analytics for Telegram channels and posts, including mentions and forwards between channels.

tools.name: Etherscan
tools.note: The standard Ethereum explorer: transactions, tokens, contracts and labelled addresses.

tools.name: ICIJ Offshore Leaks
tools.note: Searchable entities and officers from the Panama, Paradise and Pandora Papers and other leaks.

tools.name: HM Land Registry
tools.note: Who owns a property in England and Wales; title registers cost a few pounds each.

tools.name: Ghostarchive
tools.note: Archives videos and pages that other archives struggle with, including YouTube and social media posts.

tools.name: ICANN Lookup
tools.note: The registry's own RDAP record for a domain: registrar, dates, status and name servers, without a reseller's adverts in the way.

tools.name: DNSDumpster
tools.note: Maps a domain's subdomains, mail and name servers from passive DNS, and draws the result as a graph.

tools.name: IPinfo
tools.note: A quick answer to who owns an IP: ASN, hosting company, rough location and whether it is a VPN, proxy or Tor exit.

tools.name: bgp.tools
tools.note: A live BGP view of a network: what prefixes an ASN announces, who it peers with and when that changed.

tools.name: ViewDNS.info
tools.note: Reverse IP, reverse WHOIS and DNS history in one place: find the other domains sharing a server or a registrant.

tools.name: MXToolbox
tools.note: Mail records, SPF, DMARC and blocklist checks for a domain or mail server.

tools.name: grep.app
tools.note: Regex search across half a million public Git repositories. Good for finding where a leaked key, hostname or odd string turns up.

tools.name: GitHub code search
tools.note: Search all public code on GitHub with qualifiers for path, language and organisation. Needs a free account.

tools.name: PublicWWW
tools.note: Searches the HTML and JavaScript of live websites, so a shared analytics ID or snippet leads to every site that carries it.

tools.name: BuiltWith
tools.note: What a site is built on, plus its analytics and ad IDs and the other sites that share them.

tools.name: Joe Sandbox
tools.note: Deep automated analysis on Windows, Linux, macOS and Android, with a free public cloud tier for non-sensitive samples.

tools.name: Decompiler Explorer
tools.note: Upload a small binary and compare the output of several decompilers side by side.

tools.name: UnpacMe
tools.note: Automated unpacking: strips common packers and returns the payloads inside, with hashes to pivot on.

tools.name: YARAify
tools.note: abuse.ch's YARA service: scan a file against public rules, or see which samples a rule has matched.

tools.name: Flightradar24
tools.note: The most complete live map of airline traffic, with playback and aircraft history on paid tiers.

tools.name: VesselFinder
tools.note: Live AIS ship positions and vessel details by name, IMO or MMSI. A useful second opinion to MarineTraffic.

tools.name: N2YO
tools.note: Live satellite tracking and pass predictions: what is overhead, and when an imaging satellite will next see a place.

tools.name: ISW maps
tools.note: The Institute for the Study of War's daily assessments and interactive control-of-terrain maps.

tools.name: Airwars
tools.note: Civilian harm from military action, logged incident by incident with sources and locations.

tools.name: OpenStreetMap
tools.note: The open map underneath many other tools. Often names paths, buildings and features that commercial maps leave out.

tools.name: Wikimapia
tools.note: Crowd-tagged satellite map with outlines and notes on buildings and sites that other maps leave unnamed.

tools.name: Zoom Earth
tools.note: Near-live satellite imagery with weather, fires and storms. Handy for checking the cloud cover on a claimed date.

tools.name: PeakFinder
tools.note: Draws the mountain skyline from any point, to match against the ridge line in a photo.

tools.name: FotoForensics
tools.note: Error level analysis and metadata for an uploaded image, with tutorials on reading the results.

tools.name: Bing Visual Search
tools.note: Another reverse image engine. Worth running alongside Google, Yandex and TinEye, because each indexes different things.

tools.name: Jimpl
tools.note: Online EXIF viewer: drop in a photo to read camera, date and GPS tags without installing anything.

tools.name: Hunter
tools.note: Email addresses published for a company's domain, and the pattern its addresses follow.

tools.name: GLEIF LEI search
tools.note: The global Legal Entity Identifier register: who a company is, and who its direct and ultimate parents are.

tools.name: SEC EDGAR full-text search
tools.note: Full-text search of US company filings since 2001: names, addresses and subsidiaries buried in annual reports.

tools.name: OFAC sanctions search
tools.note: The US Treasury's own sanctions list search, including listed crypto addresses.

tools.name: Arquivo.pt
tools.note: Portugal's national web archive, with broad international coverage and full-text search of old pages.

tools.name: OSINT Framework
tools.note: A clickable tree of tools sorted by what you are looking for. Broad rather than curated, so check what you find.

tools.name: SunEarthTools
tools.note: Sun position, elevation and azimuth for any place and time, with shadow direction and a sun path chart across the year.

tools.name: MoonCalc
tools.note: SunCalc's companion for the moon: position, phase, and rise and set times, for dating night-time images.

tools.name: Bellingcat ShadowFinder
tools.note: Given an object's height, its shadow's length and the time, plots every place on Earth where that shadow could fall. Runs in a free Colab notebook.

tools.name: timeanddate sun calculator
tools.note: Sunrise, sunset, twilight and day length for any city on any date, past or future.

tools.name: timeanddate time zone converter
tools.note: Converts a time between places, with daylight saving applied for the date in question rather than today.

tools.name: Time.is
tools.note: Current time, time zone and UTC offset for any place, with its daylight-saving change dates.

tools.name: Meteostat
tools.note: Hourly historical weather from nearby stations, to check whether it really was raining, snowing or overcast at a claimed time.

tools.name: Weather Underground history
tools.note: Day-by-day historical observations from airports and personal weather stations, often close to the scene.

tools.name: Esri World Imagery Wayback
tools.note: Every past release of Esri's satellite basemap since 2014, to see when a building, road or crater appeared.

tools.name: NASA Worldview
tools.note: Daily global satellite imagery back to 2000: cloud, smoke, snow and fires on a given day.

tools.name: Google Earth Engine Timelapse
tools.note: Year-by-year satellite timelapse from 1984, for long-term change such as construction, mining or coastlines.

tools.name: HeyWhatsThat
tools.note: Works out what can be seen from a point: a labelled horizon panorama and a map of everything in line of sight.

tools.name: CalcMaps
tools.note: Measure distance, area and elevation on a map, or draw a radius around a point.

tools.name: OpenTopoMap
tools.note: Topographic map with contour lines and hill shading, for matching terrain, slopes and ridges.

tools.name: Yandex Maps
tools.note: Maps and street-level panoramas that often cover Russia, Ukraine, Turkey and Central Asia better than Google.

tools.name: KartaView
tools.note: Open, crowd-sourced street-level imagery. Worth a look where Google and Mapillary have nothing.

tools.name: BBBike Map Compare
tools.note: Shows the same spot on several maps and satellite layers side by side.

tools.name: Plonkit
tools.note: Country-by-country guide to visual clues: bollards, road markings, number plates, poles, scripts and more.

tools.name: MapChecking
tools.note: Estimates a crowd's size: draw its area on the map and set how densely people are packed.

tools.name: Light Pollution Map
tools.note: Night-time light from satellite, for checking what should be lit up in a night-time image.

tools.name: GeoNames
tools.note: Gazetteer of millions of place names, including old and alternative spellings, with coordinates.

tools.name: WiGLE
tools.note: Wi-Fi networks and cell towers mapped by volunteers. Search a network name or BSSID seen in a photo, screenshot or file to find where it is. Needs a free account.

tools.name: CellMapper
tools.note: Crowd-mapped mobile masts with operator, band and coverage, for placing a phone signal or testing a claimed location.

tools.name: OpenCelliD
tools.note: Open database of cell tower positions, browsable on a map. The API needs a free key.

tools.name: OpenRailwayMap
tools.note: Railway infrastructure worldwide: lines, stations, signals, gauge and electrification, for identifying a track in an image.

tools.name: Arctic Shift
tools.note: Searchable archive of Reddit posts and comments, including many since deleted, by user, subreddit or keyword.

tools.name: X advanced search
tools.note: X's own advanced search: posts by account, date range, words and engagement. Needs a signed-in account.

tools.name: telemetr.io
tools.note: Telegram channel analytics and post search, with mentions and forwards between channels.

tools.name: Statiko
tools.note: Searchable catalogue of public Telegram channels by name, @handle or topic, with growth stats and a record of posts that are later edited or deleted.

tools.name: YouTube Metadata
tools.note: Exact upload time, geotags, tags and thumbnails for any YouTube video, playlist or channel.

tools.name: Hive AI-generated content detection
tools.note: Scores whether an image, video or text looks AI-generated. Treat the score as a lead, never as proof.

tools.name: AI or Not
tools.note: A second opinion on whether an image or audio clip is AI-generated. Detectors disagree, so compare before trusting either.

tools.name: Netlas
tools.note: Internet-wide scan data: hosts, banners, certificates and DNS, searchable like Shodan, with a generous free tier.

tools.name: ZoomEye
tools.note: China-based device search engine with strong coverage of Asian networks. Its results differ from Shodan's, which is the point.

tools.name: FOFA
tools.note: Another China-based asset search engine, good for fingerprinting web panels and command-and-control servers.

tools.name: Ahmia
tools.note: Search engine for Tor onion services that filters out abuse material. Open the results in Tor Browser, not here.

tools.name: WhatDoTheyKnow
tools.note: Freedom-of-information requests to UK public bodies, with the answers. Search here before you ask.

tools.name: The Gazette
tools.note: The UK's official public record: insolvencies, company strike-offs, deceased estates and other legal notices.

tools.name: BAILII
tools.note: Free UK and Irish court judgments and tribunal decisions, searchable by party name.

tools.name: FCA Financial Services Register
tools.note: Firms and people the UK financial regulator authorises, with their permissions, trading names and warnings about clone firms.

tools.name: Charity Commission register
tools.note: Registered charities in England and Wales: trustees, accounts, income and linked charities.

tools.name: Individual Insolvency Register
tools.note: UK bankruptcies, debt relief orders and individual voluntary arrangements currently in force.

tools.name: Electoral Commission donations search
tools.note: UK political donations and loans, searchable by donor, recipient and date.

tools.name: CourtListener
tools.note: US court opinions and federal court filings drawn from PACER, free to search.
